# Nelson Ford Sales

> Nelson Ford Sales is a  dealership in Nelson. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/nelson-ford-sales-mirror/used/): 124 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/nelson-ford-sales-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability
